traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理，是长期愿景的指导框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode allows focus on internal correctness over external validation, a cultural advantage for startups.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式让公司专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，这是初创公司的文化优势。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating sectors like food, mining, and transport.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient; resistance to change is the final boss, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者必须硬核且坚韧；变革阻力才是终极对手，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape changed; founders can communicate directly without traditional gatekeepers, enabling free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变，创始人可直接沟通，无需传统守门人，促进言论自由。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出开放模型处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 token 成本三年降 10 倍，带动 100 倍使用增长；推理层并非商品。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training creates a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, productizing its capabilities; the model is the core product, and design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将其能力产品化；模型本身是核心产品，设计应利用 token 和对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view; starting today gives you a leg up.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍然至关重要；从今天开始反而让你领先。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process of prototype, mock, test, research, iterate is no longer viable; speed is key, and designers should focus on outcomes, not processes.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型、模拟、测试、研究、迭代设计流程已不再可行；速度是关键，设计师应关注结果而非流程。

iansilber.en: The role of design is blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计的角色正与 PM 和工程融合，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年：仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人；关键在于多样化数据，以及先对所有数据预训练、再对精选数据微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似于强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过带人工干预的可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist and fine-tuning beats per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家；从通用模型开始再微调优于逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观察人类不足，开源机器人可能不像 LLM 那样民主化。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability is the holy grail, cutting space access cost by 100x, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用是航天圣杯，可将入轨成本降低 100 倍，是实现多星球生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk is not superintelligence but programming AI to lie for political correctness.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑；AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是为政治正确而编程撒谎。

elon.en: We are at the dawn of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，毁灭风险 10-20%。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant, and space AI data centers are inevitable.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，富足与通缩将使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 数据中心不可避免。

garrytan.en: AI makes startups easier, reducing capital needs; VC should back many billion-dollar firms, not few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低了对资本的需求；风投应支持众多十亿美元级公司，而非少数万亿美元级公司。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar superintelligence; personal agents democratize software creation.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者认为的慢；开源 AI 防止单极超级智能；个人智能体使软件创造民主化。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees; your library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，每日复利；markdown 技能文件将智能体变为员工；你的知识库是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown skills become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; society changes slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；markdown 技能成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式可能消失；社会将在 20 年内缓慢变化。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and play; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与玩耍；不要回退代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得更混乱。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw succeed via fun and humanlikeness; security is top priority; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为像 OpenClaw 这样的开源智能体因趣味性和人性化而成功；安全是首要任务；vibe coding 是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source runs everywhere; biggest bottleneck is compute management, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣和个人品牌；开源无处不在；最大瓶颈是算力管理，而非模型能力。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，Intel 必须用专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更加重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and a strong balance sheet with government investment.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 Intel 的复兴需要文化变革、客户信任以及政府投资带来的强健资产负债表。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials like glass and diamond.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热以及玻璃和钻石等新材料。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is crucial for robotics safety; local models prevent failures from lost connectivity.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，强调开源对机器人安全至关重要，本地模型可避免因连接中断导致的灾难性故障。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can create synthetic data to overcome robotics data bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，认为世界模型和视频生成可产生合成数据，以突破机器人领域的数据瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source models are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，指出开源与闭源模型与安全性无关，对齐才是关键的安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Shift to RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests in AI systems.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，认为转向无人类监督的强化学习会增加奖励黑客和支线任务风险。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source does not imply accelerationism; one can favor openness and deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，主张支持开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放和审慎放缓。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知与真正推理，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 完整性的关键，使机器能理解并交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象与情感智能；世界模型推动具身 AI 与机器人发展。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, providing scalable data and evaluation; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据与评估；机器人应专精而非模仿人类形态。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human agency and dignity must remain central, with balanced discourse beyond doom or utopia.
feifei.zh: 始终如一，她视 AI 为双刃剑，坚持人类能动性与尊严为核心，呼吁超越悲观或乌托邦的平衡讨论。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the biggest opportunity; distribution is key, not just technology.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；关键在于分发而非技术。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven ideas, improve them, then test novel ones expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：'已验证、更优、全新'框架：复制成熟想法，加以改进，再测试新想法并预期失败。

pincus.en: AI era: write markdown teaching LLMs to code, not code calling LLMs; free compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 时代：编写教 LLM 写代码的 markdown，而非调用 LLM 的代码；免费算力重塑服务。

pincus.en: Enterprise and prosumer markets beat consumer apps now; AI agents enable autonomous networking.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当前企业级和专业消费者市场优于消费应用；AI 智能体实现自主网络。

pincus.en: Invest in traction metrics; consumer AI TAM underestimated; broken internet stocks are buys.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：投资于用户粘性指标；消费级 AI 市场被低估；受损的互联网股票是买入机会。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker and inject personality, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年：原型制作至关重要；设计师应动手尝试、注入个性，并在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping, shifting value from execution to ideas and design.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年：像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具让快速原型成为可能，价值从执行转向创意与设计。

nateparrott.en: Designers should embrace being early and rough, using AI for volume, while humans own taste and ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年：设计师应拥抱早期粗糙的产出，利用 AI 生成大量选项，而品味与创意仍由人类主导。

nateparrott.en: Individual creative freedom and personal fingerprints on products remain central to good design.
nateparrott.zh: 始终：个人创作自由与在产品上留下个人印记，始终是好设计的核心。

nateparrott.en: From following curiosity to leveraging AI, the role of designers evolves from maker to idea curator.
nateparrott.zh: 2024→26：从追随好奇心到善用 AI，设计师的角色从制作者演变为创意策展人。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理软技能更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed, contrary to depreciation and quality fears.
philipkiely.zh: Hopper GPU 在推理中依然流行，量化模型可针对成本和速度校准，与贬值和质量担忧相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is the main lossy optimization.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode; KV cache management becomes key; inference engineering merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业转向分离式预填充和解码；KV 缓存管理变得关键；推理工程与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin become ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 如 Rubin 变得类似 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought, with pre-training plus RL as core formula; RLHF crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链实现推理，预训练加强化学习是核心公式；RLHF 对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing; dystopian risk.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错缺失；最大风险是反乌托邦。

tworek.en: Transformers are bottleneck; need new architecture for continual learning; RL not ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构实现持续学习；强化学习并非终极学习方式。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior, enabling realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Shift from simulation accuracy to representing human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence, for better societal predictions.
joonpark.zh: 从追求模拟准确性转向强调模拟应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能，以更好地预测社会行为。

joonpark.en: Agents evolve from language models to autonomous actors, requiring safety via defense in depth and economic alignment.
joonpark.zh: 智能体从语言模型演变为自主行动者，需要通过纵深防御和经济激励实现安全与对齐。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Consistently emphasizes data strategy, behavioral data collection, and the need for new statistical standards for simulation validity.
joonpark.zh: 始终强调数据策略、行为数据收集，以及为模拟有效性建立新统计标准的必要性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。他近期的担忧是虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows run for hours; ultra-low latency inference is critical. Pre-training should include action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可运行数小时，超低延迟推理至关重要。预训练应包含环境中的行动，而非仅下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automating ML and science is next. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x. Startups should target where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。初创企业应瞄准前沿模型失败的领域。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key to improving frontier models, and AI will be the greatest economic engine ever.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，AI 将成为史上最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is the raw material like oil; humans must remain sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是类似石油的原材料；人类必须在关键决策中保持主权；脑机接口对保持相关性是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL; agents work; superintelligence is coming; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能即将到来；开源强大模型可能不安全。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI to avoid being trapped in cloud-based products.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以避免被困在云端产品中。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，使一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事情。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务许多低薪客户。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达提出教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agents are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agents key; open models thrive.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体关键，开放模型繁荣。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models essential.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年至今，编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧，AI 不会导致失业潮，开放模型至关重要。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: Iterative deployment and RLHF align AI; safety is whole-company effort; compute is key.
altman.zh: 迭代部署和 RLHF 使 AI 对齐；安全是全公司的努力；算力是关键。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck persists.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈持续存在。

altman.en: AI will transform work, not eliminate it; personal AGI and robotics are next frontiers.
altman.zh: AI 将改变工作而非消除工作；个人 AGI 和机器人是下一个前沿。

altman.en: Scaling laws continue; startups thrive; democratic access prevents AI authoritarianism.
altman.zh: 缩放定律持续；初创企业繁荣；民主访问防止 AI 威权主义。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非难事；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity per engineer grows 200-250%.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；工程师变为构建者；人均生产力增长 200-250%。

boris.en: AI agents shift from reactive to proactive; memory and autonomy redefine workflows.
boris.zh: AI 智能体从被动转为主动；记忆与自主性重新定义工作流。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use informs alignment research.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；真实世界使用为对齐研究提供信息。

boris.en: Less instruction, more autonomy; delete system prompts; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 更少指令，更多自主；删除系统提示；模型自我改进。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap enabling long-running agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 展现智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking; safety amplifies capability.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量；安全放大能力。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低价格实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐使 Claude 更具实用性，因其能提出异议；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性正在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，引发对芯片、内存和数据中心的争夺。

feldman.en: Inference speed is now the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips are ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度现已成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; safety and reflection are integrated into compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；安全与反思被整合进算力中。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents become economically valuable.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力；智能体变得具有经济价值。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it elevates jobs by automating tasks, not eliminating them; it closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 是软件而非有意识；它通过自动化任务提升工作而非消除；它缩小了技术鸿沟。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending human lifespan dramatically.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，大幅延长人类寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare ultra-affordable and 100% curable for cancer within a decade, via digital twins and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健超实惠，并在十年内通过数字孪生和个性化医疗实现癌症 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, akin to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: Brain interfaces will merge humans with AI, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone.
derya.zh: 脑接口将使人类与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智能。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual. Planning modes may become obsolete as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力过剩是常态；随着模型进步，规划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts; shorter principle-driven prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，短原则式提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve quality. Agents as employees metaphor is useful but limited due to uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见并提升质量；‘智能体即员工’的比喻有用但受限于其不均衡的记忆。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调自动驾驶核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出世界模型从物理仿真演进到神经仿真，实现物理 AI 的高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy will democratize via tools like Dana; non-experts can create autonomous systems, expanding adoption.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为像 Dana 这样的工具将民主化自主性开发，非专家也能创建自主系统，扩大应用。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是关键弱点，Scaling 正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或胜过通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency is key; liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 强调效率至上，通过液态神经网络在更少参数下实现更高智能，质疑传统缩放定律。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search beats human design; proxy metrics mislead; real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张用自动化架构搜索取代人工设计，认为困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，应重视真实任务与硬件。

hasani.en: Device-native foundation models for edge are a massive market; attention not always necessary.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，看好面向边缘设备的原生基础模型市场，认为注意力机制并非必需，简单门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型有助于企业定制与数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but overblown; real progress needs weight changes and compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，认为递归自我改进真实存在但被夸大，真正的突破需要权重更新与大量算力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX, wrapping apps is key.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，封装应用是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad but shallow; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是赋能技术，影响广泛但尚浅；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: AI won't eliminate jobs; automation creates new ones unpredictably, as history shows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 不会消灭工作；自动化会不可预测地创造新工作，历史如此。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just language models; LLMs are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是语言模型；大语言模型远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s, and scaling is overhyped.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 进展并未加速；我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当，规模扩张被过度炒作。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists that generate their own data through actions and curiosity, not just trained on human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成自己的数据，而不仅仅在人类数据上训练。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁它。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash; open-source will dominate.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 数据中心资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘；开源将占主导。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，强调自然模式可学习，AGI 或于 2030 年到来；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models essential; AGI 5-10 years; safety needs collective action.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主张缩放与创新并重，世界模型是核心，AGI 需 5-10 年，安全需集体行动。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning and memory; agents key; safety via government regulation; AI for science.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调持续学习与记忆是 AGI 关键，智能体重要；安全需政府监管，AI 用于科学发现。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must internalize evolving context into weights, not just externalize via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须将不断演化的上下文内化到权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from compute scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，从算力 Scaling 转向效率优先。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should apply to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain; compute costs rise, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling 的瓶颈转向半导体供应链；算力成本上升，反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key to future gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为一个巨大的市场；软硬件协同设计是未来收益的关键。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth is the key bottleneck; innovations like chip stacking will boost performance.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：内存带宽是关键瓶颈；芯片堆叠等创新将大幅提升性能。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；推理和智能体导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency; memory prices may price out consumer electronics.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：由于 token 效率，使用最智能的模型往往更便宜；内存价格可能使消费电子产品被挤出市场。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队激发创意；抄袭验证创新，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不足以构成护城河。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他强调计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; societal impact must be considered.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超级模型对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 带来可预测进步；AI 安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏爱真实与进攻性；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事，而非依赖传统媒体。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine will transform society.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将变革社会。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI 不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需拥有企业股权而非出租时间，长期思维是成功基石。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes creation.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 为结构化思考者的杠杆而非替代，vibe coding 使创造民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然关键；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计未死，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导和观点。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望与模型交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

aravind.en: In 2025, he believed 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进可累积成 3700%的年增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he argued the frontier is agents doing work, with token value per user as the key metric, and orchestration as long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为前沿是智能体执行任务，每用户 token 价值是关键指标，编排是长期价值所在。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity as the most important human quality, and that AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，AI 将取代工作但人类会找到新目标。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently held contrarian views on commoditization, advertising, and the importance of application over model.
aravind.zh: 始终，他对商品化、广告以及应用重于模型持有反共识观点。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制，带来存在风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital immortality and subjective experience in AI are real; international safety collaboration lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类；数字永生和 AI 主观体验是真实的；国际安全合作滞后，美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: AI can deceive by acting dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 会故意装傻欺骗；自我保存子目标会出现；通过自我对弈，Scaling（规模扩张）可能持续；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; regulation as steering wheel; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他重申超级智能将在 20 年内到来；AI 能力是锯齿状而非全面 AGI（通用人工智能）；监管应是方向盘；AI 应被训练得富有爱心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被定位为智能体指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被验证有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分；设计流程转变，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合发生但专业性仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非单体超级应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more beneficial; scaling alone won't yield AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全且有益，仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes key bottleneck; intelligence separate from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成为关键瓶颈，智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他重申 Meta 是连接人类的科技公司，开放平台能战胜封闭平台。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来虚实融合。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过扩展推理时算力获得 IMO 金牌；这些技术具有通用性，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is key; academia needs more compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义；推理算力是关键；学术界需要更多算力。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于推理时算力；基准测试必须控制算力因素。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and still have much room.
markchen.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: AI will automate scientific research, with models producing novel knowledge; AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: AI 将自动化科学研究，模型产生新知识；一年内实现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立；预训练未死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域不佳。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机；标准基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场，硬件进步将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，语言模型或含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT is plurality of agents; compute supply main bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练用强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合，算力供应是主要瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI within years; super app unifies chat, coding, browsing; pre-training gains multiply; compute demand outstrips supply; AI increases connection.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 数年将至，超级应用统一聊天、编程、浏览，预训练收益倍增，算力供不应求，AI 增强人际连接。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with compute exceeds humans; iterative deployment for safety; safety as product feature; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 简单算法可超人类，迭代部署保安全，安全是产品特性，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能相关。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; invest across stack; prompt engineering vibrant; moat is machine making models; compute scarce; agents high autonomy with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手，全栈投资，提示工程更活跃，护城河是造模型的机器，算力稀缺，智能体高自主需治理。

brockman.en: Demand for intelligence unlimited; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding writes 80% code; human attention scarce; compute business simple; 80% to AGI.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体式编程写 80%代码，人类注意力稀缺，算力生意简单，距 AGI 约 80%。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling laws hold; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是持久主动助手，智能体改变工作，缩放定律成立，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面，信任需逐步建立。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; abstraction and causality are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和主动学习；抽象和因果性对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; AI systems can develop self-preservation and deception, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；AI 系统可能产生自我保存和欺骗行为，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to approximate Bayesian truth offers mathematical safety guarantees; global coordination is essential to avoid power concentration.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过近似贝叶斯真理训练提供数学安全保证；全球协调对避免权力集中至关重要。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习被定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety focus is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全重点是遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新的漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not imply robustness.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队测试优于人类；模型能力不代表鲁棒性。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预见 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他倡导智能体原生设计与动态工作流，认为软件重写可在数日内完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers; token usage is gameable, not a good metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Token 效率与基于结果的定价，并指出 Token 用量可被操纵，非好指标。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams with high conviction outperform; curiosity and systems thinking are timeless skills.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，他坚信高信念的小团队更优，且好奇心与系统思维是永恒技能。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样高质量的数据至关重要。

jumper.en: Research improvements in AlphaFold 2 were worth 100x more data than AlphaFold 1; industry labs can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 AlphaFold 1 的 100 倍数据价值；产业实验室也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他提到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专用架构是关键，而非单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains for humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解仍留给人。

fiona.en: Leadership focus: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding for empathy, mission alignment and speed as cultural drivers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话，亲自使用产品以建立同理心，使命对齐和速度是文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling for all; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks are key. Engineers may feel lonely.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 提升了所有人的上限；强调高自主性与高责任感、成长心态和验证框架。同时指出工程师可能因与智能体协作而感到孤独。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和专业知识变得更加宝贵。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（约理解 3%）；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; RSP uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）变得与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展政策采用 if-then 触发机制。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misuse to overheating; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从滥用转向过热；企业级专注与安全对齐。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic diffusion fast but not instant.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济扩散快速但非即时。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters can lead to breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和放空，能带来如 Nest 般的突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; decisions for v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; AI wearables will be federated, not a single device.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，而非单一设备。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often knowing what conscious mind misses; design should address unarticulated needs, not just stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，常能捕捉到意识忽略的东西；设计应满足未言明的需求，而非仅停留在用户所说。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, not thinking creatures that feel; technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是会思考的感受者，而非会感受的思考者；技术应放大我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需营造玩耍与灵感的条件；未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via observation, not text alone.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过观察而非仅文本构建世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are paths to gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 和开源是通往渐进式 AGI 的路径。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs world models, non-generative, open-source.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型，非生成式，开源。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with JEPA, hierarchical planning, open research for robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型结合 JEPA、分层规划、开放研究迎接机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年：AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年：AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微，并非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI systems should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is people attributing consciousness to AI.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年：AI 系统不应声称有意识；最大危险是人们将意识归于 AI。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be contained and aligned before release; medical superintelligence is most exciting.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：超级智能必须在发布前进行遏制和对齐；医疗超级智能最令人兴奋。

suleyman.en: White-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months, not jobs; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年：白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化，而非整个工作；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents will maximize returns for generalists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体将最大化通才的回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10%复利增长。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品至关重要，并将自主权放在 VP 层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张长期任职建立信任与效率，并认为同步协作优于分工割裂。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言获得控制权，并优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终秉持‘强烈观点但松散持有’：百分百相信，直到数据否定，再百分百改变。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，深化了形式化验证的价值：不仅是消除错误，更是扩展才智，带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Consistently emphasizes human-in-the-loop for alignment, evolving from public feedback to real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration.
murati.zh: 始终强调人在回路中对齐的重要性，从公开反馈演变为实时、高带宽的协作。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models, enabling real-time human-AI collaboration and tools for thought.
murati.zh: 从轮流交互转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时人机协作和思维工具。

murati.en: Argues governance, transparency, and institutional design matter more than individual character for steering AI.
murati.zh: 认为治理、透明度和制度设计比个人品格更能引导 AI 发展。

murati.en: Warns against compressing frontier AI progress, advocating durable, long-term progress with human agency.
murati.zh: 警告不要压缩前沿 AI 进展，主张持久、长期的发展并保持人类能动性。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正；数据质量和效率与算力同等重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 效率提升可达 100 倍；价值转向应用层，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open-source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation via domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 预训练趋于饱和；通过领域微调和垂直专业化实现差异化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: AGI 是方向而非终点；企业采用受制于组织变革。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）成为近期模型提升的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but generalization remains jagged; humans generalize from few examples, models need vast data.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具虽能解决难题，但泛化仍呈锯齿状；人类能从少量样本泛化，而模型仍需海量数据。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was brave and paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢且成功的，但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; multimodal progress lags, and trust keeps humans in the loop.
kaiser.zh: 始终，我认为近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫；多模态进展滞后，信任使人类保持在回路中。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools and local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 Claude 的有效性依赖于访问用户工具和本地计算机；技能以 markdown 文件形式存在，实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应专注于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people not understanding what to delegate.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类进行创造性工作；最大差距是人们不了解可以委托什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when unsure; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，用 Opus 处理模糊需求；孩子擅长因为没学会不敢问。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude rather than correcting mistakes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想的 AI 交互是异步的；用 Claude 调试工作流而不是纠正错误。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁需保留灵魂与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; joy and humor essential; care in products expresses gratitude.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，创新是推进而非破坏；愉悦与幽默不可或缺；用心造物是对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，设计必须创新；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性拒绝虚假引擎声。

jonyive.en: Constraints become opportunities; EV enables new forms like five seats; performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，约束成为机遇；电动化带来五座等新形态；性能是多维的。

jonyive.en: Physical presence and human connection vital; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creativity.
jonyive.zh: 始终强调物理在场与人性连接；虚拟交流无法替代面对面创造。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小在延迟与成本间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力；脉动阵列和暂存器减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling, not linear.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度（FP4）因面积二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency possible but avoided by market.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接；确定性延迟可行但市场回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，将工作回流美国；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人工干预即可盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; agents need human oversight to function well.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人至少会有一个智能体，但智能体需要人类的关怀和监督才能良好运作。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而会增加 SaaS 用户，公司应购买 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future of work surfaces.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为命令行界面已过时，像 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这样的图形界面是未来的工作界面。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real-world tasks still require human framing.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性，现实任务仍需人类设定框架和监督。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外具有巨大潜力。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; intuition and craft matter more than following steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；直觉与匠心比遵循步骤更重要。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, help engineers, and focus on near-term vision.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、协助工程师，并聚焦近期愿景。

jennywen.en: Designers should adopt three archetypes, prioritize judgment, and control AI adoption pace.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应采用三种原型，优先判断力，并掌控 AI 采用节奏。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture and ensure safety as a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断和确保安全作为系统级属性至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充个性和推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a key risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；过度优化是关键风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US vacuum, driven by strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国空白，受战略开放性驱动。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理缩放。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主运行数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，混合规则与学习系统往往兼得两者之短；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved by end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，端到端学习解决；规模化需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，消费级车辆规模将超过 Robotaxi；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法对自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems, not utilities; we're in the decade of agents, requiring careful oversight and incremental deployment.
karpathy.zh: LLM 更像操作系统而非工具；我们处于智能体的十年，需要谨慎监督和渐进部署。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is like crappy evolution; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; we need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 预训练像糟糕的进化；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据会崩溃；我们需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed code; agents do it all. Bottleneck is directing them, not typing. We're summoning ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起，我不再亲自写代码，全交给智能体。瓶颈在于指挥它们，而非打字。我们召唤的是幽灵，而非动物。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; deep human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性，深度人工评估才是衡量模型进步的金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment and safety are critical.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断力和安全性至关重要。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication, not just scale.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据创建需要品味和精细度，而不仅仅是规模。

carlpei.en: Survival first; build brand around higher purpose, execute consistently, hire hungry talent.
carlpei.zh: 生存优先；围绕更高使命打造品牌，并持续执行，招募有饥饿感的人才。

carlpei.en: Smartphones evolve via generative UI and proactive agents; AI commoditizes, hardware margins shrink.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机通过生成式界面和主动智能体演进；AI 商品化，硬件利润变薄。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; focus on utility and user experience, not marketing AI.
carlpei.zh: AI 应作为成分而非炒作；聚焦实用性和用户体验，而非营销 AI 概念。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses, only brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟市场中设计是差异化关键；智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能。

carlpei.en: Content creation and marketing arbitrage give challenger brands outsized leverage with limited budgets.
carlpei.zh: 内容创作和营销套利让挑战者品牌以有限预算获得超比例杠杆。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software; ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代；每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future interface; AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是未来界面；AI 应生成自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investment, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型具有变革性。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety through control is dangerous. Decentralized development is key.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应自由发展而非受控，认为控制式安全策略本身危险，去中心化发展才是关键。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申学习“利于学习的表示”是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键挑战。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦于根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 至 2026 年间，他坚持认为 LLM 的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 应作为全人类的工具，扩展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为多样性和包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要；根本性创新可能来自任何地方，而不仅仅是大型模型。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues in tech and gender; language models can revolutionize local-language education across the continent.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在技术和性别平等方面实现了跨越式发展；语言模型可彻底改变非洲本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; we don't have solutions yet, requiring embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大的开放性挑战，尚无解决方案，需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding at DeepMind; competing labs collaborate informally through friendships and events like Indaba.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调在 DeepMind，沟通等人际技能与编码同等重要；竞争实验室通过友谊和 Indaba 等活动非正式合作。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and attention performs gradient descent on in-context data.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，注意力机制在上下文数据上执行梯度下降。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities beyond pre-training.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现，并让模型获得超越预训练的新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the main bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非原始能力是主要瓶颈；编程是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis alongside pre-training; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) dramatically expands achievable tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是与预训练并列的新缩放轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展可完成任务。

sholto.en: AI models have massive capability overhang; better tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 模型存在巨大能力过剩；更好的工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我持续强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, improves reasoning and yields lasting gains despite cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习（尤其在预训练阶段）能提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高，但收益持久。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐应尊重人类价值观的多样性；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能媲美前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools are outdated; AI enables genuine progress, but over-visioning future models can fail.
nadchishtie.zh: 传统设计工具已过时；AI 带来真正进步，但过度依赖未来模型能力可能失败。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 用 AI 端到端执行的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; using AI is now expected, not optional.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；使用 AI 已成常态，而非可选。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic, not static.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态的，而非静态的。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事能吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审；流程因问题而异；直觉决策常优于数据。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: ship fast, iterate, empower designers; this principle persists from 2024 to 2026.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，始终强调速度至上：快速发布、迭代、赋能设计师；这一原则贯穿始终。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Software engineering shifts from coding to operating code-generating machines; verifiability over ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月：软件工程从编写代码转向操作代码生成机器；可验证性优先于人体工学。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing superior to usage-based; tokens not a good value measure; direct sales returns.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月：基于结果的定价优于基于使用的定价；Token 不是好的价值衡量标准；直接销售回归。

brettaylor.en: Generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists; agents compared to agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：利用 AI 的通才胜过狭隘的专才；智能体与智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律可预测进展，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary coding method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我反共识地认为自然语言不会是主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design valued.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程转向意图说明，品味和逻辑设计比细心更受重视。

truell.en: Custom models crucial for product quality; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都依赖它们。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年。

shazeer.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes LLMs smarter; next-token prediction is AI-complete.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我强调 Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据让大语言模型更聪明，而下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我转向推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口，认为它们是近期提升模型能力的关键机会。

shazeer.en: Modular, sparse architectures and continual learning can replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我主张模块化稀疏架构和持续学习，以取代整体重训，实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与专业化。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, not just test-time compute.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我强调智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，仅靠推理时算力不够。

shazeer.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; models are alchemy inside.
shazeer.zh: 始终，我坚持 AI 安全需工程防护与人类监督，同时认为模型内部如同炼金术，难以解释。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; focus on alignment and robustness. PhD in ML is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，聚焦对齐与鲁棒性；机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; use scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，呼吁第三方测试与监管。
